title: How can Speech Therapy help with Hyperlexia in children with Autism?
metaTitle: Hyperlexia and Speech Therapy | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how Speech Therapy can assist children with Autism and Hyperlexia at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: Hyperlexia, or precocious reading ability, often presents itself in children with autism. While these children may be excellent readers, they can struggle with understanding what those words mean. Our skilled Speech Therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network are adept at working with children with Hyperlexia. They use techniques to improve comprehension skills, address any articulation concerns, and importantly, help kids put this language to use correctly in social interactions.
